name: browser gates — the off-origin guard and the import name warning
why: Two of the four gates named in the work-list live in Playwright, and both were meta-tested by hand. Each break below names the journey that must go red. The two 'guard blinded' breaks matter more than the two 'behaviour broken' ones: they check the floors, which are what stop a journey passing because it looked at nothing.
